## Salta, vineyards and the Andes

Salta lies in the Lerma Valley and is a starting point for journeys through northwestern Argentina. From here, the road leads to the wineries of Cafayate, high-altitude national parks, old settlements and the multicoloured slopes of the Andes.

In Cafayate, you will learn about Argentine winemaking and spend a night at a wine hotel. The route then continues through Los Cardones National Park, home to cacti aged 200–300 years.

Around Purmamarca, you will visit the Hill of Seven Colours and the Quebrada de Humahuaca, a UNESCO World Heritage cultural landscape. Indigenous fortresses, pre-Columbian and colonial settlements, old churches and cobbled streets survive here. The Salinas Grandes salt flats are another natural stop on the itinerary.
